note: MoHex 2.0 / Wolve. Paper anchor (Jones 2021, ref. 28) cites version d450c01 of Feb 25 2020, which is not in this repository; this pin is the current upstream head (2022-12-17, adds the macOS build fix). boardlaw built the same repository head at its time with gcc-7, libboost-all-dev and libdb-dev.

local_change_notes.src/util/Misc.cpp: Boost >= 1.85 removed path::branch_path() and path::normalize(); replaced with parent_path() and lexically_normal() (Boost >= 1.60). Data-file lookup only; no search or rules change.
local_change_notes.src/hex/Resistance.cpp: Resistance::ComputeScores read pointToIndex[source] uninitialised when fill-in had already joined the colour's two edges into one group (after BenzenePlayer's 'Fillin caused win' recompute); MoHex with perform_pre_search segfaulted there on Linux (g++ 13, Boost 1.83). The function now reports zero resistance for that colour and returns. Found on Modal 2026-11-13; no change to positions where the edges are separate.
local_change_notes.src/mohex/MoHexPlayer.cpp: MoHexPlayer::Search's empty-sequence fallback drew a random empty cell from the fill-in board, which after a fill-in win can have none, so MoHex answered 'invalid'. It now plays an empty cell of the real board, preferring one its own fill-in claims. Found on Modal 2026-11-13; reached only in positions decided by fill-in.
local_change_notes.src/hex/EndgameUtil.cpp: MostOverlappingMove returned (HexPoint)-1 when inferior-cell tightening emptied the candidate set (curMostHits == 0), and MoHex then segfaulted while playing a determined lost (or won) position. It now falls back to a cell of the untightened intersection, or of the smallest carrier. Found on Modal 2026-11-13; reached only in positions decided by fill-in.
